mines.mine_notes: Life-of-mine silver stream on Lundin Gold's operating FDN gold mine, Zamora-Chinchipe, Ecuador. Announced Feb 2026; definitive agreements with Lundin Gold entered April 2, 2026 (post-FY2025). Terms not yet disclosed in company filings.

1% NSR royalty on the Nacimiento I concession (San Juan Province), host to NGEx Minerals' 100%-owned Lunahuasi copper-gold-silver project. Acquired July 21, 2025 from an NGEx subsidiary for US$700,000 cash. Exploration-stage; no production.
1.38% NSR royalty on the concessions underlying the Los Helados copper-gold deposit, Atacama Region, Chile. Acquired Aug 5, 2025 (from MFDO) for cash. Development-stage; no production.

notes: New royalty/streaming company spun out of NGEx Minerals via plan of arrangement (completed Oct 23, 2025; NGEx retained 19.9%). FY2025 covers the stub period from incorporation to Dec 31, 2025 (no production or royalty revenue). Royalty interests carrying value US$1,677,848 (purchases of US$1,638,400 during the period). Net loss US$478,240; share capital US$3,257,318. CFO Peter Hemstead stepped down Jan 21, 2026. All amounts in USD.
